Unchained review: digital legacy verdict

Verdict: Collaborative-custody Bitcoin vaults (2-of-3 multisig) with inheritance planning. Strong for larger holdings. Best for: Larger Bitcoin holdings, especially in the US, where a formal inheritance process is worth paying for.

What are the pros and cons of Unchained?

Pros

  • You hold 2 of 3 keys, so Unchained can't move funds alone
  • Inheritance Protocol document set guides executors step by step
  • Trust vaults, transfer-on-death beneficiaries and estate-planning advisors

Cons

  • Bitcoin-focused
  • Premium pricing aimed at serious holders

What are similar tools?

Crypto inheritance

Casa

A leading multisig self-custody service with inheritance included in every plan, covering bitcoin, ETH and stablecoins.

Crypto inheritance

Vault12 Guard

Backs up seed phrases using trusted 'Guardians' and lets you name a beneficiary who can inherit after a 48-hour owner veto window and Guardian approvals.

Crypto inheritance

Ledger Recover

An optional, ID-based seed backup for Ledger hardware wallets. Handy for recovery, but it's a trust trade-off and isn't primarily an inheritance tool.
